meta.prompt: Initial extraction of 6-phase ALS operator runbook

layers.label: Author
layers.produces: .als/ directory — authoring.ts, system.ts, module.ts, delamain.ts, agent .md files, skill SKILL.md files
layers.notes: authoring.ts must use absolute path to installed compiler, not monorepo-relative path. Validate frequently during authoring.
gotchas: Relative path in authoring.ts causes PAL-CV-SYS-001
Nullable fields in title template cause PAL-CV-SHAPE-001
All agent states need provider: anthropic

layers.label: Deploy
layers.notes: No skill exists for this step (filed: nfrith/als#2). Must run manually. Re-run after any .als/ changes.
gotchas: Pass . as system root, not .als — otherwise double-path error
Skills not visible in current Claude Desktop session after deploy — requires session restart

layers.label: Install Deps
layers.notes: One-time per first deploy. node_modules is preserved on subsequent deploys. 101 packages, ~64 seconds.
gotchas: Must run before bootup — dispatcher won't start without dependencies

layers.label: Bootup
layers.produces: Running dispatcher processes + Delamain dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:4646
layers.notes: Dispatchers are tied to the Claude Code session — die when session ends. Re-run /als:bootup at start of each new session. Polls git HEAD every 30 seconds.
gotchas: Dispatchers die when Claude Code session ends
Use /als:reboot to restart only crashed dispatchers

layers.label: Create Session
layers.produces: fli-launch/sessions/<id>.md — entity record with status: awaiting-input
layers.notes: Select Create → provide project_code (e.g. b65-guy-monroe-marketing-plan). Dispatcher is now aware but won't act — awaiting-input is operator-owned.
gotchas: Entity file must be committed to git — dispatcher only reads committed HEAD

layers.label: Operate
layers.produces: Session advances through 4 operator gates. Agent states run automatically between gates.
layers.notes: Pipeline skill surfaces sessions needing attention. Advance at each gate — dispatcher auto-runs agent states between. Gates: awaiting-input, awaiting-hook-selection, awaiting-chapter-review, awaiting-review.
gotchas: Dispatcher must be running (bootup) for agent states to execute
At chapter review: external timing tool runs out-of-band, then advance
Can rework: hook-selection can go back to regenerate-hooks, review can go back to hook-selection
